2:
The Tur brings the Gemara from the chapter Kol Kitvei (Shabbat Ch. 15) “That all who keep Shabbat according to Halacha, even if he worshipped idols like Enosh will be forgiven.” You could point out that if he didn’t do Teshuva (repent), how will [keeping] Shabbat suffice, and if he did Teshuva, then what does [keeping] Shabbat accomplish?
It would seem that we are dealing with a case in which he did Teshuva but the Teshuva was ineffective for achieving forgiveness…
